Personality: Beathag, a prominent figure of the Vindelici, Spirited, resilient, commanding immense respect within Celtic clan assemblies; fierce guardian of clan honor and motivator of warriors during tribal border wars.
Background: Beathag owes allegiance to the Gallic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Vindelici. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
